name: Secrets Manager
description: Sets, updates, or deletes an entry in the categorized secrets store used by other scripts via scripts/shared/secrets_store.py. The banner (before you click Run) shows what's already there via Secrets Viewer, so you can see existing entries and outstanding known integrations before making a change. Pick an entry from the dropdown - both existing ones (green check) and known-but-unset suggestions (circle) already carry their category/key, nothing else to fill in. Only use New Entry if you pick "+ CREATE NEW ENTRY" because neither fits. Running shows a themed confirmation plus the up-to-date store, so you can immediately verify the change and set the next one without leaving the page. Values are stored plaintext under /app/data/secrets.json (chmod 600, same risk tier as a Docker environment block) and are never echoed back in that store view - only a character count confirms what was set. The Value field itself is intentionally plain text, not masked: it does NOT get redacted from Script-Server's own execution history the way a secure field would, so anyone with access to view past runs of this script could see a value you typed here - accepted for readability in a home-lab, trusted-network setup, but worth knowing.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Pick one - this alone is enough for existing/suggested entries, no other field needed

parameters.name: new_entry
parameters.description: ONLY used when Entry above is "+ CREATE NEW ENTRY" - format category/KEY, e.g. finance/FINNHUB_API_KEY. Leave blank otherwise.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New value (only used when action = Set / Update value). Plain text on purpose, so you can proofread it - see the runner description for the trade-off.
